description: A Portuguese home-buying or tax term explained, with the law. From the flatin.pt glossary (CPCV, escritura pública, caderneta predial, VPT, IMT, IMI, AIMI, certidão permanente…): what it means, where it comes up when buying, and the article of law with a link to the official text and the date it was checked. In the user's language. Call without `term` to list all terms.

language.description: Language of the site content in the answer (verdicts, definitions, labels) and of the page links: pt, en, ru, ua (or uk), de, fr, nl. Field names and the summary stay English. Default: en

term.description: The term: Portuguese or English name, a name in any site language or an abbreviation (CPCV, IMT, VPT, caderneta predial, escritura). Omit to list all terms

name: glossary_lookup
title: Explain a Portuguese home-buying term
